Lemma
1. Lemma 1.36\group harmonic-functions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0024, han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0025 ↗ hanlin:corollary-comparison-principle ↗ hanlin:thm-interior-gradient If $u\in C(\overline{B_1})$ is harmonic in $B_1$, has boundary data $\varphi \in C^\alpha (\partial B_1)$ with $0<\alpha <1$, then $u\in C^{\alpha /2}(\overline{B_1})$ and \[ \| u\| _{C^{\alpha /2}(\overline{B_1})}\le c(n,\alpha )\| \varphi \| _{C^\alpha (\partial B_1)}. \]
Proof

\sketch Compare $u-u(x_0)$ with the barrier $C|x-x_0|^{\alpha /2}$ at each boundary point using Corollary 3. For interior points, if their boundary distances are comparable to their separation use the boundary estimate; otherwise apply the scaled gradient estimate from Theorem 3. Combining the two cases gives the global $C^{\alpha /2}$ bound.

□
